name: hybrid-rule-based
$comment: NEDC with the rule-based energy management (EMS/strategy = 0). Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Driver.** NEDC speed (Lookup1D over time, generated from the cycle definition) and a PI speed tracker: the tractive force demand F_dem = Kp (e + int e / Ti).

**Plant (bond graph).** Engine (MSe = throttle x WOT(w), plus the unfired drag MSe) on its inertia, the input damper (C, R) onto the carrier; the planetary set (subsystem); MG1 on the sun, MG2 on the ring: inverter MTF from the DC bus, stator R (copper loss) and L, EMConverter, iron loss R; spin losses on the ring; ring -> final drive TF -> half shafts (C, R) -> wheel (friction brake MR) -> tyre -> vehicle mass I with drag MR, rolling resistance MSe and grade Se. Battery (Thevenin, OCV table), DC-link C and the auxiliary load R on the bus.

plots.title: Engine operating points (torque vs speed) on the WOT and optimal lines

parameters.name: m_veh
parameters.description: Vehicle mass with driver (Prius NHW20 curb 1310 kg + 75 kg)

parameters.name: m_rot
parameters.description: Equivalent mass of the four wheels' inertia, 4 J_w / r^2

parameters.name: J_ring
parameters.description: Ring gear and counter drive gear inertia

parameters.name: J_mg2
parameters.description: MG2 rotor inertia (ORNL rotor mass 10.2 kg)

parameters.name: P_aux
parameters.description: 12 V auxiliary load through the DC/DC converter (assumed)

parameters.name: soc_ref
parameters.description: Target state of charge of the energy management (at standstill)

parameters.name: eta_kin
parameters.description: Share of the kinetic energy the SOC target keeps room for (0: a fixed target)

parameters.name: P_min_kW
parameters.description: Rule-based: least engine power while it runs

parameters.name: s0
parameters.description: ECMS: equivalence factor (fuel per electric energy, both as power)

parameters.name: interp_ocv0
parameters.description: Open-circuit voltage at soc0 (the DC-link start voltage)

options.text: The **energy manager** chooses when the engine runs and at which point; MG1 holds the engine speed through the sun gear, MG2 fills in the wheel torque and recovers the braking energy. Switch the strategy, change the target SOC or the ECMS equivalence factor, then **Run**.
